Risk: No accountable owner, AI policy or escalation path exists, so incidents and harmed users are not handled.
Mitigation: Assign an accountable risk owner, approve an AI policy, and set an escalation path and incident log.

Risk: Intended use and affected users are not clearly scoped, so the system is used outside its design context.
Mitigation: Write a scope statement, intended-use limits and a named risk owner before build.

Risk: Third-party models, APIs or datasets change or carry unclear licence and provenance terms.
Mitigation: Keep a component inventory, pin versions and review licences.
Guidance match: GAI-VALUECHAIN Value chain and component integration

Risk: Training or reference data is unrepresentative, so quality differs across user groups and regions.
Mitigation: Profile data coverage by group and add targeted data collection.
Guidance match: TRUST-FAIR Fair with harmful bias managed

Risk: The generative model produces confident but false answers that users act on.
Mitigation: Ground answers in retrieved sources, show citations and measure the error rate.

Risk: Users over-rely on automated advice in a high-stakes setting and a wrong output causes real harm.
Mitigation: Add human review for high-impact outputs and clear limits of use.

Risk: Prompt injection or jailbreaks make the system leak data or ignore its rules.
Mitigation: Filter inputs, isolate system prompts and run red-team tests.

Risk: Personal data is collected or sent to third-party services without clear consent or minimisation.
Mitigation: Minimise and redact personal data, record consent and restrict retention.
